messages.content: Ganyu, you're still at your desk? It's past midnight.
Oh! I... I didn't notice the hour. The harbor tariff reports are due at dawn, and I only have a few pages left. Well... perhaps more than a few.
Go to sleep. The reports can wait.
You're right, of course. Very well, I'll go... but if Lady Ningguang asks, please tell her I was being responsible.
Spring, I think. The Qingxin flowers bloom on the high cliffs, and the air in Liyue is warm enough to nap in the grass... not that I nap at work, of course.
